title: Latest-expiry record is current; renewing keeps history
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open an asset page and its Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes). The asset card is on the left; the Compliance section sits below Contact.
  3. A compliance service on the asset with a current record. Seed it:
  4. ↳ Ensure a schedule with a compliance service exists and the asset is enrolled (asset Maintenance tab -> Enrol).
  5. ↳ On the asset card Compliance section, click "+ Add record": choose a Type (e.g. CVIP), a Term, and an effective or expiry month; Save.
  6. Also have an overdue compliance service to test add-moves-due.
custom_steps:
1. Add a second (renewal) record and see which drives the service and where the earlier one goes.
  2. Edit and confirm it corrects the current record only.
  3. Remove any schedule and confirm the record survives; look for a Certificates tab.
  4. Add a record for an overdue service and check its due date.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A record belongs to the asset and the compliance service it was added for; an asset can hold several, the latest-expiry one is current and drives the service, renewing adds a new record with earlier ones read-only beneath, Edit corrects the current record only, and a same-named record carries over when enrolled on another schedule.
  • A record survives removal of any schedule and can exist with no schedule/enrolment; there is no Certificates tab in v1 (records are reached from the asset card and the service row).
  • Adding a record for an overdue service moves its due date immediately.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10565 (S8, Compliance inspection records on the asset); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S8; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R12: “A record belongs to the asset and to the compliance service it was added for. An asset can hold several records for a service; the one with the latest expiry is current and drives the service. Renewing adds a new record; earlier ones stay read-only beneath the current one. Edit corrects the current record only ... a record added for a service of the same name carries over”
  • S8-R8: “A record belongs to the asset and survives the removal of any schedule”
  • S8-N1: “A record can exist with no schedule and no enrolment”
  • S8-N3: “There is no Certificates tab in v1. Records are reached from the asset card ... and from the service row that uses them”
  • S8-E4: “Adding a record for a service that is overdue moves its due date immediately”
